positive_snippets: Great communication and affordable price. Staff really good in communication and good service. We'll use them again whenever I come to Delhi. Food and chai is delicious.

Pocket friendly but superb. Located in a calm and safe place in East Patel Nagar Market. Room was clean, comfortable bed, clean washroom. Good restaurants, cafes and markets are near by. Nearest metro is Rajinder place is about 1km, can be reach by foot or by 3 wheeler. Staff are really good.
negative_snippets: We had a leisure of 3 hrs so we booked , but the receptionist behaviour was too bad and horrible , is this the way they treat their guest then dont book here , arrogant behaviour by the receptionist and charged extra money just for being 10/15 min late . Please go for a good hotel than this dont stay here

This is the worst experience ever. Wasted time and money. The hotel is completely different from photos. The room and specially the bathroom has a pungent smell. The towel in washroom was stinky and dirty. Floor tile was broken. Beds were uncleaned. No proper room service and food was hell. The lift does not work there. And they charge extra than the MRP for water.

The room is horrible sheets are filthy bathroom and room both very outdated and smell of damp. I wish I knew what I am paying for not happy with the price charged. Wifi keep dropping. Not worth the money. I asked the guy to change the quilt cover when he took the old cover off it was so disgusting. If they charging for hotel they should change the bad worn out covers and other items. Mattress is so worn out! 😡😡
